  "overall_experience": "This HR Generalist likely found LiveAgent to be a generally effective tool for centralizing support communications across a large hospital and healthcare organization. While it offered beneficial features like scheduled request processing and chat location visibility, the experience was tempered by occasional performance issues and bugs that could disrupt workflow.
